classificationPolicy.confirmed_clean: Reproduced on the isolated tracked baseline.
classificationPolicy.dirty_only: Reproduced only after applying the dependency/runtime candidate patch.
classificationPolicy.not_reproduced: Not reproduced in either controlled environment.
classificationPolicy.blocked: A required runtime, route, deployment, or fixture was unavailable.
classificationPolicy.pending_reconciliation: Reported evidence exists, but P24-00R has not classified it yet.

findings.title: Clean and dirty environments report different build results
findings.note: Do not attribute the build failure to product code until commit, lockfile, Node, and package patch are isolated.

findings.title: Vercel observation URL redirects anonymous users to SSO
findings.note: Human observation cannot start until an anonymous or explicitly provisioned URL is available.

findings.title: KST morning defaults can use the previous UTC date
findings.note: Separate local calendar date from UTC serialization.

findings.title: Today summary ignores an Item date override
findings.note: Summary, full list, Calendar, and ICS must use the same effective date resolver.

findings.title: Reuse keep-fixed-dates option behaves like reset-to-anchor
findings.note: The new run must honor the selected overlay transfer policy while preserving past history.

findings.title: Recurrence preview shows many occurrences but saved projections show one
findings.note: Preview, My Flow, Calendar, and ICS occurrence counts must match.

findings.title: The same recurring task can appear as both next task and next item
findings.note: Keep one executable occurrence row and render any next preview without completion control.

findings.title: Memo-split todo Items can be persisted but hidden from UI and export
findings.note: Item type must not remove a persisted Item from the effective list.

findings.title: Empty miss input can create a fallback draft
findings.note: Require title or desired outcome and never persist a status sentence as an Item title.

findings.title: Direct /flows navigation can remain in loading fallback
findings.note: Reproduce in production mode after build environment is fixed.

findings.title: Post-save My Flow can intermittently render empty until reload
findings.note: One of five automated saves reproduced the stale hydration.

findings.title: Uncompleting a task requires leaving Today and opening detail
findings.note: Keep Today and All roles, but support one-action reopen in the current context.

findings.title: Personal Item edit form exposes unrelated generic fields
findings.note: Use progressive disclosure and Item-intent field gating.

findings.title: Date move lacks explicit single, selected, anchor, and recurrence scopes
findings.note: Define pure transitions, preview, history, and undo before UI.

findings.title: Unscheduled Items are difficult to discover from Calendar
findings.note: Expose a Calendar-local unscheduled tray without creating fake dates.

findings.title: Calendar export appears Flow-level but exports the current Item
findings.note: Choose whole, selected, or current scope before choosing a destination.

findings.title: Reflection is concentrated at the end of a Flow
findings.note: Optional inline notes can aggregate into final reflection without becoming mandatory.

findings.title: Arbitrary unregistered URL conversion is not available for user testing
findings.note: Test the honest miss/draft path now; production fetch and real AI remain gated by security, rights, retention, and cost.

findings.title: Source-backed structural edit controls are absent without an explanation
findings.note: Do not add another explanation card until actual users show confusion.

findings.title: Tracked dependency baseline has high advisories while candidate upgrade is unstable
findings.note: Run a controlled upgrade separately from product fixes; do not use npm audit fix --force.
